column1: # Captured on the CI ephemeral stack (empty Postgres) at 26d149b, the first
# run in which the frontend rendered at all — before the app/.env fix in that
# commit every one of these 68 returned 500.
# Not a statement that these are CORRECT. It records what each page family
# does on an empty database so that a change which moves any of them fails.
# The 3 x 500 and 1 x 404 below are data-dependent on this empty stack and
# are recorded as-is, deliberately, rather than chased.
# ⚠ UPDATED 2026-09-16 for an INTENDED change, which is the only reason a row
# here may move: /research/digital-reform/master-agreements was renamed to
# /agreements (owner decision) and the old path now 302s, exactly as /expiring
# and /licenses already do. Both rows are listed, so the redirect itself is
# covered and a future change that turns it into a 404 fails here.
